title: Ubiquiti: Enterprise NAS, Built on ZFS
summary: Ubiquiti announced their new Enterprise NAS solution built on ZFS, expanding from their networking hardware into the storage market. The product targets small-to-medium businesses seeking enterprise-grade data storage with ZFS features like snapshots, data integrity verification, and compression.
problem_solved: Provides enterprise-level NAS storage with ZFS data protection features at potentially lower cost than traditional enterprise storage vendors.
why_valuable: Brings Ubiquiti's value-oriented enterprise approach to storage, offering ZFS benefits (end-to-end checksums, snapshots, cloning) to businesses building on their UniFi ecosystem.
